t: Dine nesiat kappayim veezeh debarim happoselim bekohen
s: Dine nesiat kappayim veezeh debarim happoselim bekohen ubo s' seipim: mitzvat aseh min hattora sheyyebareku hakkohanim et yisrael bekol yom binsiat kappayim, shenneemar: koh tebareku vego'", ulehallan hu omer: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayborkem". Umishshennaseu kappehem ubereku paam achat bayyom — yatzeu yede chobatan min hattora. Vachakamim tiqqenu sheyyisu kappehem bekol tepilla min hattepillot shebbayyom, (ve)shacharit umusap (detaanit) uneila umincha detaanit, vegam bemincha shel kol yemot hashshana haya rauy lihyot bah nesiat kappayim, ella shemmaneu mishshum chashash shikrut, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"t. Veen nesiat kappayim bepachot measara, sheim hayu asara keshehitchil hashsheliach tzibbur y"ch veachar kak yatzeu miqtzatan ap al pi shehu gomer kol hattepilla en sham nesiat kappayim shemmitzvat aseh bipne atzmah hi ella sheqqebauhu chakamim battepilla abal im hayu asara keshehitchilu hakkohanim lebarek veachar kak yatzeu miqtzatan — gomerin birkatam, vehu shennishtayyeru rubban. Vehakkohanim olim leminyan asara o rob asara, lepi sheggam hem biklal habberaka, shenneemar: "vaani abarakem", kelomar lakkohanim. Vaapillu t' kohanim veyisrael echad — mebarekim oto, shebbirkat kohanim neemeret bilshon yachid "yebarekka vego'":
Zar shennasa et kappayv apillu im hakkohanim — ober baaseh, shenneemar: "dabber el aharon veel banayv lemor koh tebareku et bene yisrael" velo zarim, velav habba mikkelal aseh — aseh:

Kol kohen sheen bo echad mehaddebarim hamakkebin sheyyitbaer im lo ala laddukan ap al pi shebbittel mitzvat aseh achat — hare zeh keober beg' aseh: "koh tebareku", "amor lahem", "vesamu et shemi". Vehu sheyyihyeh bebet hakkeneset kesheqqara hashsheliach tzibbur "kohanim", o im echad mishshear haam amar lo laalot o littol yadayv, shenneemar: "amor lahem", umetargeminnan "kad temar lehon". Veim lav — eno mechuyyab kelal lissa kappayv, ella im rotzeh. Vehu sheaqar raglayv ba"aboda" laalot laddukan, abal im lo aqar raglayv ba"aboda" — shub eno oleh, apillu haya bebet hakkeneset kesheqqareu "kohanim", vaapillu ameru lo laalot, kemo sheyyitbaer. Umikkol maqom, im ameru lo qodem ha"aboda" — chayyab hu laaqor raglayv ba"aboda", shello yaabor al g' aseh. (Veap im lo ameru lo qodem ha"aboda" ella sheyyodea sheyyiqra hashsheliach tzibbur "kohanim" — tzarik hu laaqor raglayv ba"aboda", shello yigrom sheyyebuttal mitzvat aseh shel tora, shehare birkat "aboda" vekol hattepilla hi middibre soperim unesiat kappayim hi min hattora, ella sheyyesh koach beyad hachakamim laaqor debar tora besheb veal taaseh, vehem menauhu minnesiat kappayim kol shello aqar raglayv bebirkat "aboda" ap al pi sheqqoreim oto veomerim laalot, im ken lekattechilla en ligrom laaqor debar tora. Lepikak kol kohen shehu chalush veeno rotzeh lissa kappayv — lo day lo shello yaaqor raglayv ba"aboda", ella tzarik hu shello yihyeh bebet hakkeneset kesheqqore hashsheliach tzibbur "kohanim"):

Veim ala kebar paam achat beyom zeh — shub eno ober apillu ameru lo "aleh", shekkebar yatza yede chobato min hattora, vetaqqanat chakamim shettiqqenu nesiat kappayim bekol tepillat tzibbur — yekola lehitqayyem bekohanim acherim. Umikkol maqom, im rotzeh laalot paam shenit beyom zeh — yakol lebarek qodem sheyyissa kappayv apillu beoto tzibbur shekkebar nasa kappayv hayyom, kegon beshacharit umusap (veap al pi shehu eno mechuyyab lissa kappayv mitztzad atzmo, mikkol maqom taqqanat chakamim hi shettihyeh nesiat kappayim bitpilla zo, veyakol lebarek alayv kemo al kol shear taqqanot umitzvot dibre soperim):

Kohanim sheenam rotzim laalot laddukan veyotzeim mibbet hakkeneset — en tzerikim lishhot chutz lebet hakkeneset ella beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur qore "kohanim" veachar kak rashshaim likkanes, sheap shehem bebet hakkeneset kesheshshear hakkohanim noseim kappehem vehem enam noseim kappehem — en bekak kelum, kevan shei epshar lahem laalot, ukesheqqareu "kohanim" lo hayu bebet hakkeneset velo qareu lahem kelal. Umikkol maqom, hakkohanim nahagu silsul shello likkanes ad sheyyigmeru hashshear birkat kohanim, kede shello yomru alehem shehem pegumim, dehaynu bene gerusha o chalutza, im yihyu bebet hakkeneset kesheachehem hakkohanim noseim kappehem vehem enam noseim immahem. Umittaam zeh yotzeim mibbet hakkeneset qodem "retzeh", shello yomru alehem shehem pegumim kesheyyiru et achehem hakkohanim sheoqerim raglehem laalot laddukan vehem enam oqerim. Veken mittaam zeh ap happesulin linsiat kappayim shello mechamat pegamam yotzeim mibbet hakkeneset bishat haddukan, shello yomru alehem shehem pegumim. Umikkol maqom, im lo yatzeu mibbet hakkeneset kesheqqore hashsheliach tzibbur "kohanim", vaapillu ameru lahem laalot — lo yaalu, apillu enan pesulin ella middibre soperim. Veap al pi shekkesheeno oleh kesheqqorein o omerim lo hare hu ober al mitzvat aseh, mikkol maqom yesh koach beyad chakamim laaqor dabar min hattora besheb veal taaseh, ulepikak eno ober kelum kevan shechakamim menauhu:

Taqqanat chakamim shello yaalu kohanim laddukan besandalim o beminalim, gezera shemma tippaseq leechad retzuot hassandal o hamminal veyityare shello yitlotzetzu alayv veyesheb leqoshrah vachaberayv mebarekin, veyabou lomar alayv shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza ulepikak halak veyashab lo. Vaapillu minalim sheen bahem retzua mequshsheret — asur, shello chillequ chakamim bigzeratam ben minal leminal. Abal batte shoqayim muttarim, apillu enan batte shoqayim umiknasayim yachad ella qosherim otah birtzua samuk laarkubba — en chosheshin shemma tippaseq haretzua veyesheb leqoshrah, shello chasheshu (chakamim) ella birtzuot sandal sheggenay hu lo umitlotzetzin alayv keshessandalo mutteret, abal behattarat retzua sheqqosherin bah batte shoqayim — en bah genay kol kak. Veyesh omerim shemmikkol maqom im hem shel or asurim, shebbiklal minal hem ubeminalim lo chillequ veaseru apillu en bo retzua kelal. Veim hem shel beged mechuppeh or — enam biklal minal leinyan zeh umuttarim. Vaapillu shel or lebad im hem batte shoqayim umiknasayim yachad kevan shemmaggiim ad hammotnayim — enan biklal minalim. Abal nahagu biqtzat meqomot lehaqel bebatte shoqayim bekol inyan:
Tob lizzaher lehatznia hamminalim tachat hassapsalin shello yihyeh megullim venirin, mippene kebod hatzibbur:

Kol kohen shello natal yadayv — lo yissa et kappayv, shenneemar: "seu yedekem qodesh ubareku et Hashem". Veap al pi shennatal yadayv shacharit — tzarik lachazor velittol lipne aloto laddukan, shettihyeh tekep lah beraka, veshiur tekipa yitbaer besiman qs"v, velaken tzarik littol samuk li"retzeh" (ubi"retzeh" hem oqerim raglehem laalot laddukan, kemo sheyyitbaer. Vehashsheliach tzibbur lo yaarik bi"retzeh" ub"modim"). Veshiur netila zo keshiur qiddush yadayim lipne aboda shebbammiqdash, dehaynu ad happereq shehu chibbur hayyad vehazzeroa. Veepshar shetztzarik gam ken mayim shello nishtannu mibberiyyatan kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"s, vesheyyabou hammayim al yede hakkohen mikkoach adam kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qn"t, ukemo beqiddush yadayim shebbammiqdash:

Veen lebarek al netila zo, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheyyotze yede chobato bintilat shacharit, velo hitzriku littol lipne nesiat kappayim ella keshehissiach dato mishshemirat yadayv achar netilat shacharit. Usepeq berakot lehaqel. Veyesh meqomot nohagin shebbitpillat shacharit en notelin yadayim linsiat kappayim ubemusap notelin mippene hessach haddaat, veap al pi ken en mebarekin, apillu im yadua shehissiach dato, lepi sheepshar shehessach haddaat eno posel linsiat kappayim kemo sheeno posel lishar dibre tora, velo hitzriku littol yadayv linsiat kappayim ella keshennageu yadayv bimqom hattinnopet, velo day lahen niqqayon beolma kemo lishar dibre tora. Lepikak im yadua lo shennaga bemaqom metunnap achar shebberak al netilat yadayim shacharit — ledibre hakkol chayyab littol ulebarek al netilat yadayim shenit qodem aloto laddukan. Abal mah laasot shello nahagu ken, laken kol kohen yare vechared yishmor yadayv mishsheat netilato shacharit shello ligga bemaqom hamluklak sheyyitchayyeb lebarek al netilat yadayim paam b':

Nohagim shehallevi yitztzoq mayim al yede hakkohanim, al shem "vegam et acheka matteh levi vego' haqreb ittak veyillavu aleka vishortuka". Ukede shehakkohanim yosipu qedushsha al qedushshatam, shemmaqdishim yedehem min halleviyyim hanniqraim qedoshim, shenneemar: "veqiddashta et halleviyyim". Velevi hamqaddesh yede hakkohanim — yesh lo lehitqaddesh atzmo techilla, sheyyittol yadayv qodem sheyyitztzoq al yede hakkohanim, sheek yosip qedushsha vehu eno qadosh. Ubimdinot ellu somekin halleviyyim al netilat yadayim shacharit, abal im naga bemaqom metunnap — rauy hu sheyyittol yadayv techilla. Veim en sham levi — yitztzoq bekor peter rechem, shehallevi hu qadosh al yado. Abal bekor leab bilbad en bo qedushsha akshav, shennittal haaboda mibbekorot. Veim en sham lo levi velo bekor — tob sheyyittol yadayv hakkohen beatzmo mishsheyyittol al yede yisrael, shemmutab sheyyitqaddesh al yede atzmo shehu qadosh mishsheyyitqaddesh al yede yisrael sheeno qadosh kemoto:

Im hallevi chakam vehakkohanim amme haaretz — en tzarik litten mayim al yedehem, shello yezalzel bikbod torato. Veim miqtzat hakkohanim talmide chakamim — tzarik litztzoq al kullam, mippene darke shalom. Veyesh mi sheomer sheap im kullam amme haaretz tzarik litztzoq mayim al yedehem (mippene darke shalom, kemo shekkohen am haaretz oleh liqrot battora lipne levi chakam mippene darke shalom kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"h). Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona (lepi shekkeshehallevi monea atzmo besheb veal taaseh veeno holek lesharet hakkohanim litztzoq mayim al yedehem — en lachosh lemachaloqet kol kak kemo sheyyesh lachosh bechakam haoleh liqrot battora rishon bipne hakkohen). Umikkol maqom, im rotzeh levi limchol al kebodo velitztzoq al yede kohanim — rashshay, venakon laasot ken kede lehosip qedushsha al qedushshat hakkohanim. Veen bazeh issur mishshum zilzul torato (kevan sheeno mesharet et hakkohanim derek choq umishpat kehunna ella mitkavven lehosip qedushsha al qedushshatam, veen issur kelal lechakam lezalzel et atzmo mishshum ezo hiddur mitzva vehosapat qedushsha, veadderabba zehu kebodo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"n):

Kol kohen sheeno oleh laddukan qodem sheyyesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur birkat "aboda" — shub eno oleh, shenneemar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayborkem", veachar kak "vayyered measot hachattat vego'", mashma shebberak qodem shennistalleq mehaaboda, laken tiqqenu battepilla sheyyaalu hakkohanim laddukan qodem siyyum birkat ha"aboda". Veap im lo yaalu laddukan mammash ella sheoqerim raglehem laalot ap al pi shello higgia laddukan ad leachar "retzeh" u"modim" — hare zeh keillu ala ba"aboda". Ulekattechilla yaaqor kol kohen mimmeqomo keshemmatchil hashsheliach tzibbur "retzeh":

Apillu im haya anus velo aqar raglayv ba"aboda" — lo yaaleh, veim ala — lo yered. Veim aqar raglayv mibbeto labo lebet hakkeneset velo kede laalot laddukan — en aqira zo moelet kelum. Abal im aqar raglayv mibbeto labo lebet hakkeneset kede laalot laddukan — aqira zo moelet im hayeta qodem shessiyyem hashsheliach tzibbur birkat "aboda", kegon shehaya beto samuk lebet hakkeneset:

Kesheoqerim hakkohanim raglehem laalot laddukan — omerim: "yehi ratzon millepaneka Hashem elohenu velohe abotenu, shettehe beraka zo shetztzivvitanu lebarek et ammeka yisrael beraka shelema, velo yihyeh bah mikshol veavon meatta vead olam". Vetob shello yomru tepilla zo miyyad sheoqerin raglehem ba"aboda", ella yamtinu ad achar sheyyomru "modim" im hashsheliach tzibbur veaz yachaziru penehem lahekal veyomru tepilla zo, veyaariku bah ad sheyyesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur birkat "hodaa", kede sheyyaanu haqqahal amen al shettehem:

Keshehem omedin baddukan upenehem kelappe hekal vaachorehem kelappe haam — etzbeotehem kepupot letok kappehem kishar bene adam, veenan poshetin uporesim yedehem ad sheyyiqra lahen hashsheliach tzibbur "kohanim", sheaz machazirim penehem kelappe haam uposhetim yedehem, shenneemar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayborkem", mashma sheppashat yadayv bishat habberaka (sheim hayu yadayv kepupot letok hakkap — nimtza shello nasa vehigbiah kol hayyad legamre). Veen hashsheliach tzibbur qore "kohanim" ella lishnayim, shehappasuq "amor lahem", shettargumo "kad temerun lehon", mashma lishnayim. Abal im en sham ella kohen echad — eno qore lo, ella hu meatzmo machazir panayv venose kappayv umebarek qodem sheyyissa kappayv (veap al pi shemmitztzad atzmo eno mechuyyab lissa kappayv kemo shennitbaer leel kevan sheen qorein lo). Vaapillu im hem b' ella sheechad mehen qatan — en qoreim lahem:

Yesh meqomot sheen omerim "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'" keshehakkohanim noseim kappehem, ella miyyad keshemmesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur birkat "modim" qore beqol ram "kohanim". Veen qeria zo chashuba hepseq battepilla, hoil unesiat kappayim hu tzorek hattepilla. Abal bimdinot ellu nohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur omer "elohenu velohe abotenu ku'" belachash ad millat "kohanim" sheomerah beqol ram, vehi qeria lakkohanim, vechozer veomer "am qedosheka kaamur" belachash. Umippene zeh en qeria zo chashuba hepseq, kevan sheomerah bilshon beraka utepilla:

Keshemmachazirim penehem kelappe haam — mebarekin: "asher qiddeshanu biqdushshato shel aharon vetzivvanu lebarek et ammo yisrael beahaba". Vekullam mebarekim. Velo yebarek echad vehaacherim yaanu amen, mippene hatterup. Veyesh omerim lebarek beraka zo kesheppenehem kelappe hahekal qodem sheyyachaziru penehem. Veyesh nohagin lehatchil habberaka kesheppenehem kelappe hahekal umachazirim penehem vegomerim, latzet yede b' hassebarot. Uledibre hakkol mebarekin qodem sheyyisu veyipresu kappehem, shennesiat kappayim hi iqqar mitzvat (hattora), vekol hammitzvot mebarek alehem ober lehatchalat asiyyatan lekattechilla. Abal hachazarat penehem enah miggup hammitzva, ap al pi shehi meakkebet kemo sheyyitbaer:

En tzarik lihyot pene hakkohanim kelappe hashsheliach tzibbur, ella apillu im hahekal qabua batztzapon vehatteba shehashsheliach tzibbur lepaneha hi bammizrach — hakkohanim omedim lipne hahekal batztzapon upenehem laddarom kelappe haam. Umikkol maqom en hahekal meakkebam kelal binsiat kappayim, sheapillu bemaqom sheen sham seper tora hakkohanim machazirim penehem kelappe haam umebarekim:

B' kohanim hassoneim zeh et zeh — muttarim laalot beyachad. Veen echad yakol lomar lachabero "aleh atta beshacharit vaani bemusap" o lehippuk, ki yakol lomar "ani rotzeh lebarek bishtehen". Abal kohen hassone et hatztzibbur o hatztzibbur soneim oto — sakkana hi lakkohen im yissa et kappayv (velaken yetze mibbet hakkeneset). Veal zeh tiqqenu babberaka "lebarek et ammo yisrael beahaba":

Achar habberaka qodem shemmatchilin "yebarekka" — tzerikim lehagbiah yedehem keneged kitpotehem, shebbirkat kohanim enah neemeret ella binsiat kappayim. Veyesh lehagbiah yad haymanit qetzat lemala mehassemalit, veremez laddabar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav", ketib "yado". Uposhetim yedehem, mittaam shennitbaer. Venohagim lachaloq rashe etzbeotehem, al pi hammidrash "metzitz min hacharakkim" — sheshshekina lemala merashehem umetzitz mibben charakke etzbeotehem. Venohagin lekavven laasot Hashem avirim: ben b' etzbaot leb' etzbaot avir echad, uben etzba laagudal, veken beyad sheniyya, uben gudal laggudal, leqayyem metzitz min hacharakkim, uben teba leteba rashshaim leqareb haagudalim zeh bazeh (vehu haddin shear etzbaot). Veyesh nizharin bishat amirat hattebot lehanniach agudal yamin al semol sheyyihyeh keen challon benehem, kede sheyyihyeh Hashem challonot (she"charakkim" hu targum shel challonot). Venahagu lipros yedehem beinyan sheyyihyeh tok kappehem keneged haaretz vaachore yedehem keneged hashshamayim, hepek mipperisat yadayim litpilla:

Mitzva lehaqrot lakkohanim kol teba veteba, shenneemar: "amor lahem yebarekka vegomer", vedareshu chakamim shettihyeh amira lahem al kol dibbur vedibbur, sheim lo ba hakkatub ella letargumo "kad temerun lehon" — lo haya rauy liktob "amor lahem" lipne habberaka ella lipne "koh tebareku", shehare enan metzuvvim lebarek ella im ken qareu lahem, ella kavvanat hakkatub sheap im chal alehem hatztzivvuy lebarek kegon sheqqareu lahem — mitzva lomar lahem kol habberaka milla bemilla, kede shello yitu. Umikkol maqom en zeh meakkeb kelal kemo sheyyitbaer, kevan shekkavvanat hakkatub hi shekkebar chal alehem hatztzivvuy mishsheqqareu lahem. Veyesh omerim shettebat "yebarekka" matchilin hakkohanim meatzmam veen tzarik lehaqrot, shebbeteba rishona en lachosh letaut (veap sheddareshu chakamim shettihyeh amira al kol dibbur vedibbur, mikkol maqom beteba rishona day baamira sheameru lahem lebarek, dehaynu kesheqqareu otam "kohanim", sheqqeria zo hi amira lahem sheyyebareku, veen beraka pechuta mitteba achat. Abal leachar sheameru tebat "yebarekka" — hare bereku kebar beraka achat veqiyyemu mah sheameru lahem lebarek, laken tzarik lachazor velomar lahem al kol dibbur vedibbur. Lepikak im hu kohen echad sheen qorin lo — tzarik lehaqroto ap tebat "yebarekka", kede shettehe amira al kol dibbur vedibbur). Ubimdinot ellu nohagin kassebara harishona, lehaqrot ap tebat "yebarekka" bekol inyan:

Lekattechilla nakon sheyyihyeh hashsheliach tzibbur maqre otam, lepi shebbirkat kohanim hi mikkelal hattepilla laken tob sheyyomrenna hammitpallel, ella im ken hu kohen kemo sheyyitbaer. Umittaam zeh gam ken en haqraatam otam chashuba hepseq battepilla:

En mebarekin ella bilshon haqqodesh ubaamida ubeqol ram ubinsiat kappayim. Vaapillu bediabad lo yatzeu im shinnu beachat meelleh. Bilshon haqqodesh — shenneemar: "koh tebareku", ad sheyyomru ballashon hazzeh. Baamida — shenneemar: "leshorto ulebarek bishmo", mah sherut meummad shenneemar "laamod lesharet" — ap beraka meummad. Abal hatzibbur rashshain lesheb, raq sheyyihyeh penehem neged pene hakkohanim, shenneemar: "amor lahem", keadam haomer lachabero shemmedabber immo panim el panim (abal bediabad en zeh meakkeb, shehare ir shekkullah kohanim kullam olim laddukan ap al pi sheen mebarekin keadam haomer lachabero panim keneged panim, kemo sheyyitbaer). Beqol ram — shenneemar: "amor lahem", keadam haomer lachabero sheomer lo beqol kede sheyyishma — ap kan en omerim habberaka benam leben atzmam belachash ella ad sheyyishmeu kol haam asher yeshno poh. Ulekattechilla tzarik lomar bamulleh shebbaqqolot, lo gadol velo qatan, ella benoni:

Hakkohanim onim achar hammaqre al kol milla umilla ad sheyyesayyemu pasuq rishon, veaz onin hatzibbur amen. Veken achar pasuq b'. Veken achar pasuq g'. Veachar kak matchil hashsheliach tzibbur "sim shalom", veaz hakkohanim machazirim penehem lahekal veomerim: "ribbon haolamim asinu mah sheggazarta alenu, aseh atta mah shehibtachtanu, hashqipa mimmeon qodsheka min hashshamayim ubarek et ammeka et yisrael". Venohagim lehaarik bitpilla zo ad sheyyesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur birkat "sim shalom", kede sheyyaanu hatzibbur amen al shettehen. Veim enam yekolim lehaarik kol kak — yomru "addir bammarom ku'", vikavvenu ligmor im hashsheliach tzibbur. Uberosh hashshana veyom kippur shemmaarikim banniggunim "hayyom teammetzenu" — yesh mi sheomer shello yatchilu "ribbon" ad lebassop, sheyyigmeru im hashsheliach tzibbur:

En hakkohanim rashshaim lehachazir penehem min hatzibbur lahekal ad sheyyatchil hashsheliach tzibbur "sim shalom". Veenam rashshaim lakop etzbeotehem mippeshitatan lihyot kishar bene adam ad sheyyachaziru penehem min hatztzibbur. Veenam rashshaim laabor min haddukan velelek ad sheyyesayyem sheliach tzibbur birkat "sim shalom", ella omedim sham kepupim lipne hahekal. Velo yedabberu ad sheyyeredu min haddukan. Veyesh mi sheomer shetztzerikim lehamtin millered ad sheyyikleh amen mippi rob hatzibbur achar birkat "sim shalom", shekkol shello kolta aniyyat amen mippi rob haonim — adayin lo nistayyema habberaka kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"d. Veken hamminhag:

Keshemmachazirim penehem, ben battechilla shemmachazirim penehem min hahekal kelappe haam ben bassop shemmachazirim penehem min hatzibbur lahekal — lo yachaziru ella derek yamin, shekkesheomedim techilla upenehem lammizrach — yipnu letzad darom veachar kak lammaarab neged hatztzibbur, ubachazaratam lammizrach — yipnu letzad tzapon shehu yeminam kesheppenehem kelappe hatztzibbur lammaarab:

Kesheyyoredin min haddukan — lo yachaziru achorehem lahekal, ella yetzaddedu veyachaziru penehem qetzat lahekal, ketalmid hanniptar merabbo shemmachazir panayv elayv betzeto millepanayv. Veachar sheyyaredu — yizzaharu shello yiggeu beminalehem hamtunnapim. Veim nageu — yittelu yedehem litpilla sheyyitpalelu achar kak. Veap im enam metunnapim — tzerikim littol yedehem im nageu bahen, mippene sakkanat ruach raa, kemo shennitbaer besiman d':

En haqqore "kohanim" rashshay liqrot "kohanim" ad sheyyikleh mippi (rob) hatztzibbur amen sheonim achar birkat "modim", bammeqomot sheen omerim "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'" keshehakkohanim noseim kappehem (shead sheyyikleh amen mippi (rob) hatztzibbur — i epshar lakkohanim lishmoa qeriato otam, sheb' qolot keechad enam nishmaim). Veen hakkohanim rashshaim lehatchil birkat "asher qiddeshanu biqdushshato shel aharon", ad sheyyikleh dibbur qeriat kohanim mippi haqqore. Veachar shebbereku hakkohanim "asher qiddeshanu biqdushshato shel aharon" — enam rashshaim lehatchil "yebarekka" ad sheyyikleh mippi kol hatztzibbur amen sheonim achar birkat "asher qiddeshanu biqdushshato shel aharon". Veap im yesh batztzibbur (ezeh) qetzat shettoim umaarikim beamen yoter midday, beinyan sheap shelleachar shekkolta tebat "yebarekka" mippi hammaqre bimdinot ellu sheqqorin gam tebat "yebarekka" adayin lo kolta amen mippihem — tzarik lehamtin alehem, lepi shehu chiyyub al kol haam asher yeshno poh lishmoa kol habberaka mippi hakkohanim, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal hammaqre en tzarik lehamtin ella ad sheyyikleh amen mippi rob hatztzibbur, sheen choba kelal al hatztzibbur lishmoa mehammaqre ella al hakkohanim (umikkol maqom qodem sheyyikleh amen mippi rob hatztzibbur i epshar lakkohanim lishmoa min hammaqre, sheb' qolot enam nishmaim). Veyesh mi sheomer sheggam haqqore kohanim tzarik lehamtin ad sheyyikleh mippi kol hatztzibbur amen shel birkat "modim". Veken hammaqre tzarik lehamtin ad sheyyikleh mippi kol hatztzibbur amen shel birkat "asher qiddeshanu", sheim yiqra kohanim o maqre otam beod sheqqetzat maarikin beamen — lo yishmeu hakkohanim qeriato lahem o haqraato otam, sheb' qolot enan nishmain. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem:

En hakkohanim rashshaim lehatchil batteba ad shettikleh hatteba mippi hammaqre (kede sheyyishmeu hatztzibbur hatteba yapeh mippi hakkohanim velo titareb bah shemiatam mehammaqre). Veen hatztzibbur onin amen ad shettikleh beraka mippi hakkohanim, ben bepasuq rishon, ben bepasuq b' o g'. Veen hashsheliach tzibbur rashshay lehatchil "sim shalom" ad sheyyikleh amen mippi rob hatztzibbur. Abal im yesh miut shemmaarikin baamen — en tzarik lehamtin alehem, kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"d. Umiyyad shemmatchil "sim shalom" — omerim hakkohanim "ribbon haolamim":

En hashsheliach tzibbur rashshay laanot amen achar (siyyum) beraka shel kohanim, mippene hatterup shemma titbalbel dato velo yukal lekavven lachazor lebirkat "sim shalom", shekkevan shehu mekavven baaniyyat amen karauy — hissiach dato lemachashaba acheret velo yukal lachazor maher litpillato veyiteh, mah sheen ken kesheeno oneh amen hu noten dato al tepillato beshaa shehatztzibbur onin. Abal mippene hepseq battepilla en lachosh beamen sheachar birkat kohanim, lepi shebbirkat kohanim mikkelal hattepilla hu. Veim mubtach beatzmo sheyyachazor litpillato belo terup haddaat — rashshay. Veyesh mi sheoser. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Vekol shekken akshav shemmitpalelin mittok hasseper, sheen lachosh kol kak letaut:

Veken hammaqre et hakkohanim, ben shehu sheliach tzibbur ben acher — lo yaaneh amen achar siyyum pasuq a' o b' shel birkat kohanim, shemma lo yukal lekavven maher ladaat lehatchil pasuq shelleachareha, sheyyitallem mimmennu ezo pasuq yesh lo lehaqrot im b' o g'. Abal achar birkat "asher qiddeshanu biqdushshato shel aharon" yesh mi shemmattir laanot amen apillu lepi minhagenu sheqqorin gam tebat "yebarekka", lepi shezzeh en lachosh kelal sheyyitallem mimmennu techillat habberaka, veen chosheshin ella shemma yitchallep lo pasuq b' beg' (abal bitchillat habberaka en lachosh lezeh, shemmittaam zeh yesh meqomot sheen maqrin kelal tebat "yebarekka" mippene sheen lachosh bah letaut. Veap leminhagenu shemmaqrin otah — eno mishshum chashash taut, ella mishshum sheddareshu chakamim shetztzarik lihyot amira al kol dibbur vedibbur, kemo shennitbaer lemala). Vaapillu hu sheliach tzibbur — en amen zeh chashub lo hepseq battepilla, mippene shehu tzorek hattepilla, shennesiat kappayim hu mikkelal hattepilla vei epshar linsiat kappayim belo beraka shellepanayv, veim hu mubtach sheyyukal lekavven maher ladaat ezeh pasuq yesh lo lehaqrot — rashshay laanot amen achar pasuq a' o b', ubiprat akshav shemmaqrin mittok hasseper:

Veken sheliach tzibbur shehu kohen apillu en sham kohanim acherim — lo yissa kappayv, mippene hatterup shemma lo yukal lachazor litpillato ladaat lekavven ulehatchil be"sim shalom", sheddato metorepet meemat hatztzibbur. Veim hu mubtach beatzmo shehu nose kappayv vechozer litpillato belo terup daat, im en sham kohen ella hu — yissa kappayv, kede shello titbattel nesiat kappayim. Veketzad yaaseh? Yaaqor raglayv meat ba"aboda" laalot laddukan veyomar ad birkat kohanim, shekkol kohen sheen oqer raglayv ba"aboda" laalot laddukan — shub eno oleh. Ukesheyyaggia lebirkat kohanim — yaaqor mimmeqomo legamre veyaaleh laddukan vibarek birkat kohanim, veacher yihyeh maqre oto birkat kohanim, abal lo yiqra lo kohanim o kohen, sheen qoreim ella lishnayim kemo shennitbaer lemala, velaken lo yomar hammaqre "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'", shekkevan sheeno qore kohanim bebaqqasha zo en inyan lehammaqre, ella yomrenna hashsheliach tzibbur kemo sheomerim bekol hayyamim sheen bahem nesiat kappayim, shebbaqqasha zo mikkelal hattepilla, shellaken enah chashuba hepseq kemo shennitbaer lemala, veachar sheyyigmor birkat kohanim — yachazor limqomo visayyem "sim shalom". Veim hammaqre kivven libbo litpillat hashsheliach tzibbur merosh vead sop velo sach baemtza — yoter tob sheyyaamod hammaqre lipne hatteba bimqom hashsheliach tzibbur miyyad achar "naeh lehodot", veyomar "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'", veyihyeh maqre oto, visayyem hu sham "sim shalom" (kede shello tihyeh hattepilla mupseqet bahalikat hashsheliach tzibbur mehaddukan limqomo lipne hatteba). Ukeshehammaqre mesayyem "sim shalom" — yesh omerim sheyyissa hashsheliach tzibbur et kappayv apillu eno mubtach lachazor litpillato, vehu shehammaqre hu mubtach (lachazor le"sim shalom"), vegam sheyyukal lekavven litpillat hashsheliach tzibbur ad "sim shalom", velo yatridennu mah sheyyitztarek lehaqrot lashsheliach tzibbur. Veyesh oserin ad sheyyihyeh hashsheliach tzibbur mubtach. Ak akshav shemmitpalelin mittok hasseper — hakkol mubtachim. Abal im lo kivven hammaqre litpillat hashsheliach tzibbur merosh vead sop o shessach baemtza — eno yakol lesayyem "sim shalom", shellekattechilla din chazarat hashsheliach tzibbur kedin tepillat lachash, shemmi shetztzarik lachazor velomar beraka achat mi"ch tzarik lomar kullan al hasseder kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"t, vehu haddin besheba shel shabbat veyom tob, ukeshekkivven litpillat hashsheliach tzibbur — hare zeh keillu hitpallel beatzmo, sheshshomea keoneh, ukeshessach baemtza — hare hipsid mah sheshshama kebar, vetzarik lachazor larosh im haya ken bitpillat lachash kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d, veken im baemtza pana lebabo lidbarim acherim — hare hipsid mah shello shama, veen lo lesayyem "sim shalom", kevan sheepshar sheyyesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur. Abal sheliach tzibbur shettaa veeno yodea lachazor veober acher tachtayv — lo hitzrikuhu lachazor lerosh hattepilla mippene torach hatztzibbur, ella chozer lammaqom shettaa hashsheliach tzibbur kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"v:

Vekol zeh kesheen sham kohen ella hu, sheaz hittiru laaqor raglayv battepilla kede shello titbattel nesiat kappayim, shehi tiqqun chakamim bekol tepilla hareuya lekak kemo shennitbaer lemala, abal im yesh sham kohanim acherim hareuyim linsiat kappayim apillu im hashsheliach tzibbur mubtach sheyyachazor litpillato belo terup haddaat — eno rashshay laaqor raglayv laalot laddukan. Veyizzaharu haam shello lomar lo laalot o littol yadayv. Abal im ameru lo — tzarik laalot (apillu eno mubtach) im ameru lo ba"aboda" o qodem laken, shehare ober baaseh im eno oleh, umippene chashash terup ubilbul hattepilla — en lo laabor baaseh, shettepilla hi middibre soperim. (Abal keshei epshar lo — eno ober kelum, ap al pi shehu bebet hakkeneset kesheqqoreim "kohanim", mippene shehaqqore eno mitkavven liqrot et hashsheliach tzibbur kelal, hoil veasur lo laaqor raglayv, vekol shehaqqore eno mitkavven lo — eno ober apillu hu bebet hakkeneset, kegon im nistar achore haammudim shebbebet hakkeneset shello yirennu haqqore, mippene shemmin hassetam haqqore eno mekavven biqriato ella lakkohanim hannirim viduim. Vekol shekken hashsheliach tzibbur shebbevadday en haqqore mitkavven lo ella lishar hakkohanim bilbaddam. Vaapillu haya mitkavven gam lehashsheliach tzibbur — eno ober kelum, kevan shello aqar raglayv ba"aboda" umenauhu chakamim millaalot, sheyyesh koach beyad chakamim laaqor dibre tora besheb veal taaseh. Veap sheasur ligrom laaqor dibre tora vehaya lo laaqor raglayv ba"aboda" kevan sheyyodea sheyyiqqareu hakkohanim kemo shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom issur zeh eno ella middibre soperim, vehem ameru vehem ameru, vehittiru issur zeh kan shello lehapsiq battepilla baaqirat raglayv letzorek mitzva sheepshar lah lehitqayyem al yede acherim). Veyesh mattirin lishliach tzibbur kohen laalot laddukan apillu yesh kohanim acherim, veen issur baaqirat raglayv hoil udebar mitzva hu, vehu shemmubtach sheyyachazor litpillato kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veakshav shemmitpalelin mittok hasseper — hare kullam mubtachim. Velaken nahagu bimqomot harbeh sheshsheliach tzibbur kohen nose kappayv bekol inyan. Abal bemaqom sheen minhag — yesh linhog kassebara harishona, ki ken iqqar:

Keshehashsheliach tzibbur kohen veeno oleh laddukan im shear hakkohanim — lo yiqra hu lahem "kohanim", velo yihyeh maqre otam, vehu haddin lekohen acher sheeno yakol lehaqrot, shenneemar: "amor lahem", mikkelal shehaomer eno mehem ella miyyisrael. Ulepi shellekattechilla nakon shehashsheliach tzibbur yihyeh maqre birkat kohanim kemo shennitbaer lemala, lepikak mishtaddelin lekattechilla sheyyihyeh hashsheliach tzibbur yisrael. Ukeshehashsheliach tzibbur kohen — yaamod yisrael etzlo veyatchil "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'", veqore "kohanim" umaqre otam, vehashsheliach tzibbur omed veshoteq ad sheyyigmeru birkat kohanim, umesayyem hashsheliach tzibbur "sim shalom" apillu im kivven libbo hammaqre litpillat hashsheliach tzibbur, shekkevan shehashsheliach tzibbur omed bimqomo — lamma lanu lechalleq hattepilla lishnayim (mah sheen ken keshehashsheliach tzibbur oleh laddukan, kemo shennitbaer). Veim en sham yisrael sheyyakol lehaqrot — yesh mi sheomer sheyyebareku belo haqraa kelal. Veyesh omerim shehashsheliach tzibbur hu maqre ap al pi shehu kohen, shello menauhu lakkohen lehaqrot ella lekattechilla bemaqom sheepshar lehaqrot kemashmaut hakkatub lepi peshuto (abal keshei epshar beinyan acher — somekin al midrash sheddareshu qetzat chakamim: "amor lahem", shettehe amira mishshellahem, shekkohen qore "kohanim", vehu haddin shemaqre otam. Veken iqqar):

En hakkohanim rashshaim lenaggen bebirkat kohanim b' o g' niggunim, mishshum terup haddaat, shekkesherotzim latzet minniggun leniggun — tzerikim lekavven uledaqdeq yapeh lehashmia qol shaveh umeyushshar, veal yede shemmatridim datam bezeh — lo yedeu ezeh pasuq o teba yatchilu. Veap shehammaqre qore lipnehem, mikkol maqom im tittarep datam yishkechu gam ken qeriat hammaqre. Ella yenaggenu niggun echad merosh vead sop. Vehu haddin lishliach tzibbur bitpillato — en lo lenaggen niggunin harbeh bitpillato beinyan echad:

Beshaa shehakkohanim mebarekim haam — lo yabbitu baam velo yassichu datam, ella yihyeh enehem kelappe matta kemi sheomed battepilla bekavvana, shehare hem mitpalelim sheyyebarek haqqadosh baruk hu et kol yisrael, vehaam hamqabbelim et habberaka gam ken yekavvenu labberaka, veyihyu penehem neged pene hakkohanim mittaam shennitbaer lemala, velo yistakkelu bahem shello yassichu datam, vekol shekken shello yistakkelu bemaqom acher. Velaken nahagu bimqomot harbeh leshalshel hattallit shel mitzva al penehem videhem, kede shello yukelu lehistakkel baam velo haam bahem, lo bipnehem velo bidehem. Ubimdinot ellu nahagu shehakkohanim meshalshelin hattallit al penehem kede shello yukelu lehistakkel lebad, abal yedehem chutz lattallit kede shehem atzman lo yukelu lehistakkel bidehem velo yabou lide hessach haddaat, vehaam meshalshelin hattallit gam ken al penehem kede shello yukelu lehistakkel bide hakkohanim. Uminhag zeh yoter nakon lihyot nesiat kappe hakkohanim geluyim venirim velo tehe tallita[m] chotzetzet ben kappehem lehaam, ki ken hu mashmaut hakkatub: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayborkem", shello yihyeh dabar chotzetz beno laam. Velo ameru "apillu mechitztza shel barzel enah mapseqet ben yisrael laabihem shebbashshamayim" kemo sheyyitbaer, ella kesheyyesh tzibbur hammitborkim mehakkohanim bebet hakkeneset azay gam mi shehu chutz lebet hakkeneset mitbarek immahem, ella shebbediabad en zeh meakkeb, shehare ir shekkullah kohanim kullam olim laddukan kemo sheyyitbaer (abal tallit sheal pene haam betela legabbe gupam kishar malbushehem veenah chotzetzet). Velo aseru ella lehistakkel, abal reiyya beolma mutteret. Ak nohagin lizzaher:

Am sheachore hakkohanim enam biklal beraka, shebbirkat kohanim eno ella panim keneged panim kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal millipnehem ubetziddehem — apillu mechitztza shel barzel enah mapseqet ben yisrael laabihem shebbashshamayim, raq sheyyachaziru penehem kelappe hakkohanim. Utzedadim shelleacharehem — kilacharehem, kegon otam haomedim bekotel mizrachi vehahekal bolet qetzat lebet hakkeneset vehakkohanim omedim lepanayv, ap al pi shehaomedim etzel hakkotel hopekim penehem kelappe hakkohanim — enan biklal beraka. Veam shebbassadot, kevan shehem anusim shetterudin bimlaktam veenam yekolim labo lebet hakkeneset — hem biklal beraka apillu hem achore hakkohanim. Abal kol mi shehu bair veyakol labo lebet hakkeneset leqabbel habberaka panim el panim kedat shel tora veeno ba — mareh beatzmo sheen habberaka chashuba beenayv labo lebet hakkeneset bishbilah, lekak eno biklal beraka im hu achore hakkohanim. Laken kol mi shehu bair veyakol labo lebet hakkeneset leqabbel habberaka, vaapillu haomedim bachatzar bet hakkeneset veenam yekolim likkanes lebet hakkeneset mippene sheen lahem maqom sham, mikkol maqom im omedim achore kotel mizrachi — enam biklal beraka, shehare yekolim laamod letzad maarab shehu neged pene hakkohanim, o yaamdu litzdade bet hakkeneset veyahapku penehem lebet hakkeneset kelappe hakkohanim. Veken haomedim bebet hakkeneset bekotel mizrachi — enam anusim, ap al pi sheakshav kol echad qoneh lo maqom bebet hakkeneset veen echad yakol laamod bimqom chabero, mikkol maqom yekolim lelek limqom hakkohanim shehu panuy, o laamod beemtza bet hakkeneset (al habbima, o beruach maarabit shel bet hakkeneset, o bachatzar bet hakkeneset letzad maarab, o litzdade bet hakkeneset im epshar lishmoa sham birkat kohanim). Veyesh mi shellomed zekut alehem lomar shekkevan shehahekal mechubbar lakkotel — hare hu kegup hakkotel, ukeillu hakkohanim omedim samuk lakkotel mammash, vahare hem keillu haomedim bitzdade hakkohanim mammash, raq sheyyahapku penehem kelappe hakkohanim. Abal anshe maaseh nizharin lehitracheq mikkotel mizrachi velelek letzad maarab qetzat ad sheyyihyeh penehem neged pene hakkohanim o neged tziddehem mammash:

Ir o bet hakkeneset shekkullah kohanim, im en sham ella asara — kullam olim laddukan. Lemi mebarekin? Laachehem shebbassadot. Umi oneh acharehem amen? Hannashim vehattap. (Veap al pi sheen mi sheqqore lahem kohanim veen mi shemmaqre otam — en bekak kelum, shehaqqeria vehahaqraa enan meakkebot kelal kemo shennitbaer lemala. Uledibre haomerim shekkohen sheeno oleh yakol liqrot ulehaqrot, gam kan hashsheliach tzibbur sheeno oleh, apillu hu mubtach shello tittarep dato, shehare hu kohen veyesh kohanim acherim — hare hu qore umaqre). Veim yesh sham yoter measara — hayterim measara yaalu vibareku, vehaasara onim acharehem amen (veyizzaharu shello liqrot "kohanim" bebet hakkeneset, shello yaabru ellu haasara baaseh, sheap shehaqqore eno mitkavven ella lehayterim measara, mikkol maqom mi mepis mi hem hayterim). Veim yesh sham yisrael echad — hare kol hakkohanim olim umebarekim, veyisrael zeh oneh acharehem, sheapillu yisrael echad rauy hu leqabbel habberaka mittaam shennitbaer lemala. Abal kohanim ap al pi shehem mitborkim im yisrael bebirkat kohanim, mikkol maqom enam chashubim leqabbel habberaka bilbaddam ella im ken hem asara, lepikak kesheen mehem asara meqabbelim habberaka bebet hakkeneset — kullam olim umebarekim laachehem shebbassadot. Veken hannashim vehattap ap al pi shehem biklal habberaka, mikkol maqom enam chashubim leqabbel habberaka bilbaddam:

Beshaa shehakkohanim mebarekim — en lomar shum pasuq, ki kelum yesh ebed shemmebarekim oto bishlichut rabbo veeno maazin umekavven labberaka shemmeborko rabbo, veim hayu omerim happesuqim lo hayu yekolim lekavven labberaka, lekak yesh lishtoq ulekavven labberaka. Umikkol maqom, akshav shehakkohanim maarikim harbeh beniggunim — nahagu lomar gam ken pesuqim bishat haarakat hanniggun. Ak yoter tob shello leomram. Vehaomerim yomru beshaa shehammaqre maqre hatteba umamshikah beniggun:

Kohen eno rashshay lehosip middato yoter al hag' pesuqim shel birkat kohanim, veim hosip — ober al "bal tosip" im amar binsiat kappayim ubehachzarat panim kelappe haam (velaken omerim "hashqipa ku'", mippene shekkebar pashetu kappehem vehecheziru penehem). Abal im omer g' pesuqim ellu kamma peamim beyom — eno ober al "bal tosip", shello shayyak "bal tosip" ella bemosip al hammitzva atzmah velo baasiyyat hammitzva b' peamim:

Lepikak kohen shennasa kappayv veachar kak halak lebet hakkeneset acher umatza tzibbur shello higgiu lebirkat kohanim — yakol lissa kappayv shenit umebarek al nesiat kappayim zo, ap al pi shekkebar yatza yede chobato binsiat kappayim harishona kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Kohen shello hitpallel adayin umatza tzibbur mitpallel — nose kappayv veen hattepilla meakkabto. Veim yare sheim yaaleh laddukan yaabor zeman tepilla — yelek chutz lebet hakkeneset veyitpallel, sheim yihyeh bebet hakkeneset kesheyyiqreu "kohanim" velo yaaleh — yaabor baaseh. Abal im ameru lo laalot o littol yadayv — lo yelek hachutza lehitpallel ella tzarik laalot shello yaabor baaseh, shehattepilla hi middibre soperim venidchet mippene mitzvat aseh shel tora. Veim mityare sheyyaabor zeman qeriat shema — yiqraenna belo birkoteha. Veim en penay liqrot kullah — yiqra pasuq rishon lehaomerim sheppasuq rishon bilbad hu min hattora (o parasha rishona lehaomerim shepparasha rishona middeorayta, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"v):

Veken kohen haomed bitpilla veameru lo laalot laddukan o littol yadayv — tzarik lehapsiq velaalot apillu yesh sham kohanim acherim. Veim lo ameru lo — eno poseq im yesh sham kohanim acherim (veap al pi shehu bebet hakkeneset kesheqqoreim "kohanim" — eno ober mittaam shennitbaer lemala besaip l"g). Veim en sham kohanim acherim — poseq veoleh, kede shello titbattel nesiat kappayim:

Ellu happesulim linsiat kappayim middibre soperim: mi sheyyesh lo mumin bepanayv o beyadayv, kegon sheyyadayv hen kepupot o aqummot letziddehen, o shehen bohaqaniyyot dehaynu shemmenummarot binquddot daqqot. Veken im panayv bohaqaniyyot o aqummim — lo yissa et kappayv, mippene shehaam mistakkelin bo ubaim lide hessach haddaat. Vehu haddin mi sheyyesh lo mumin beraglayv, bemaqom sheolin laddukan belo batte shoqayim, shehammumin geluyim umistakkelin bahem. Abal mumin shebbasseter enan poselin linsiat kappayim, ap al pi shepposelin laaboda shebbammiqdash. Velo huqqesha nesiat kappayim laaboda ella leinyan amida, shenneemar: "laamod lipne Hashem leshorto ulebarek bishmo", laamida huqqesha — velo ledabar acher (sheim lo ba hakkatub ella lelammed al sherut shehi baamida, hare kebar neemar "laamod lesharet", veshana alayv hakkatub leakkeb, shenneemar: "haomedim sham vego'"):

Veken mi sheriro yored al zeqano o sheenayv zolepot dima, veken suma apillu beachat meenayv — lo yissa et kappayv, mippene shemmistakkelin bo. Veim haya dash beiro, dehaynu shehem regilim bo umakkirim hakkol sheyyesh bo oto mum, ben sheoto mum hu bepanayv ben beyadayv veraglayv — yissa et kappayv, vaapillu hu suma bishte enayv. Vekol mi sheshshaha l' yom bair bemum zeh — niqra dash beiro. Vehu shehi iro sheddar bah o shebba lagur bah veshaha bah sheloshim yom, vaapillu lo ba lehishtaqqea bah lihyot mibbene hair ella ba lihyot melammed o soper o mesharet shana o chatzi shana — niqra dash beiro bishloshim yom, lepi shergilim bene hair lissa velitten immo bidbarim umistakkelin bo, vehergel ayin hu belame"d yom kemo hergel hallashon shennitbaer besiman qy"d. Abal im holek beaqray leir acheret veshaha bah l' yom — eno niqra dash beiro (ad sheyyishheh bah y"b chodesh), lepi sheen bene hair regilin lissa velitten immo:

Im minhag hammaqom leshalshel hakkohanim tallit al penehem, apillu yesh bepanayv kamma mumin — yissa et kappayv, kevan sheen lachosh lehessach haddaat. Abal im en hamminhag ken veratza zeh shemmum bo leshalshel tallito — asur, shekkevan shehu meshunneh mechaberayv — yabou lehistakkel bo veyassichu datam. Vaapillu ratzu kol hakkohanim leshalshel tallitam — en lehattir, shekkevan shello hurgelu bene hair leshalshel tallitam, kesheyyeshalshelu akshav makkirim haam shebbishbil zeh sheyyesh bo mum hu, ubain lehistakkel bo. Vekol shekken im hu lebaddo nose kappayv umeshalshel tallito shello keminhagam, shennikkar shebbishbil mum shebbo hu, veyabou lehistakkel bo. Veken im minhag hammaqom sheyyede hakkohanim hen lipnim min hattallit sheal penehem, apillu yesh kamma mumim beyadayv — yissa et kappayv. Veyesh mi sheomer shehu haddin im minhag haqqahal lekassot penehem battallit, apillu yesh bepanayv veyadayv kamma mumin — yissa kappayv. Veen nohagin ken:
Hayu yadayv tzebuot istis upua — lo yissa kappayv, mippene shehaam mistakkelin bahen, ella im ken dash beiro. Veim rob anshe hair melaktam bekak — yissa et kappayv ap al pi sheeno dash beiro:

Mi sheeno yodea lachtok haotiyyot, kegon sheomer lealpi"n ayni"n uleayni"n alpi"n, sheap sheen ayi"n bebirkat kohanim, mikkol maqom kesheomer "yaer Hashem" — mechaze keomer yaer, sheayi"n veale"p shavin etzlo. Veken mi sheqqore le"sibbolet" "shibbolet" ul"shibbolet" "sibbolet", veken mi sheqqore lecheti"n hehi"n, veken kol kayyotze bazeh — lo yissa et kappayv. Ella im ken kol bene iro qorein kak, kegon bimdinot ellu sherubbam kekullam enam yodeim lehabchin ben ayi"n leale"p, lepikak lo shayyak pesul zeh benenu. Veyesh mi sheomer sheap bimqomot shemmetzuyim harbeh anashim meod sheen mabchinim ben "shibbolet" le"sibbolet" — noseim kappehem (lepi sheen happesul mechamat sheen yakol lomar haot karauy, ella mippene shemmebi et haam lide hessach haddaat, shehem temehim alayv keshemmeshanneh qeriat haotiyyot, ubimqomot shehen regilim beshinnuy zeh — en chosheshin lo veen massichim datam min habberaka. Ulepi zeh en lachosh im qore leayni"n alpi"n apillu im kol anshe hammaqom qorim karauy, shekkevan sheen ayi"n bebirkat kohanim — en lachosh lehessach haddaat. Veiqqar kassebara harishona, shehappesul hu mippene shemmishtanna mashmaut leshon habberaka. Veen hetter ella bimqomot sherubbam kekullam qorin kak, sheetzlam mashmaut habberaka kak hi):

Qatan apillu hu ben y"g shana ella shello hebi b' searot — eno nose et kappayv bipne atzmo, sheen kebod hatztzibbur lihyot kepupim lebirkato. Abal im kohanim acherim shehem gedolim, apillu eno ben y"g shanim sheyyodea lissa et kappayv — nose immahem kede lehitchannek bemitzvot. Verashshay lebarek al nesiat kappayv, kemo shemmebarek al shear mitzvot shehu patur mehen min hattora umechannekin oto bahen middibre soperim. Umishshehebi b' searot nose kappayv apillu bipne atzmo beaqray, velo biqbiut ad sheyyitmalle zeqano, mishshum kebod hatztzibbur, sheen kebodam sheyyeborkem yechidi biqbiut mi shello nitmalle zeqano. Vekol mi shehiggia lashshanim sherauy lehitmalleot zeqano dehaynu ben k', ap al pi shello nitmalle zeqano — dino kenitmalle, venose kappayv apillu yechidi beqeba. Veeno niqra qeba ella keshennose kappayv bekol yom, abal bimdinot ellu sheen hakkohanim nosein kappehen ella baregel, apillu nose kappayv bekol regel veregel — en zeh ella beaqray, verashshay lissa kappayv yechidi apillu hu pachut mibben k' (raq shetztzarik ledaqdeq besaarotayv, shello yabo lide beraka lebattala):

Kohen sheharag et hannepesh apillu beshogeg — lo yissa kappayv, shenneemar: "ubepariskem kappekem alim enay mikkem, gam ki tarbu tepilla enenni shomea, yedekem damim maleu". Vaapillu asa teshuba, shehare neemar "gam ki tarbu tepilla enenni shomea vego'". Veyesh omerim sheim asa teshuba — nose kappayv, velo maneu mimmennu nesiat kappayim ella kesheomed bemirdo, veyesh lehaqel al baale teshuba shello linol delet bipnehem. Veken nohagin. Veim haam merannenim acharayv shehu shopek damim veomed bemirdo, kevan shello nitbarer haddabar — yissa kappayv. Veken im mal tinoq umet — nose kappayv, ki shemma lo kalu lo chodashayv. Vaapillu yadua shekkalu lo chodashayv, kevan shennitkavven lemitzva — en leposlo minnesiat kappayim. Veken im dachap ishsha hara vehippila — nose kappayv, shehahoreg et haubbar patur apillu im kalu lo chodashayv:

Kohen shehemir dato, apillu ledat hayyishmeelim sheenam obedim aboda zara — (qenasuhu chakamim lihyot) mechullal miqqedushshato, veeno nose kappayv, veeno qore battora rishon. Vehu shello asa teshuba, abal im asa teshuba apillu hemir dato laaboda zara vechazar bo — chozer liqdushshato. Ushear aberot chutz mimmemir dato veshopek damim apillu gilluy arayot — en monein nesiat kappayim apillu lo chazar bo, kemo sheyyitbaer. Lepikak arel nose kappayv apillu lo mal atzmo bemezid. Veap al pi shearel pasul laaboda — en leposlo linsiat kappayim mishshum shehuqqesha beraka lesherut, ki lo huqqesha ella laamida bilbad, kemo shennitbaer lemala saip m"d. Umikkol maqom, hoil vehuqqesha beraka laaboda bemiqtzat — aseru chakamim leshikkor lissa kappayv kemo sheosra tora leshikkor laabod aboda bammiqdash, kemo shekkatub: "yayin veshekar al tesht vego'". Vesameku issur zeh lemah shennismeka parashat kohen mebarek leparashat nazir, mah nazir asur beyayin — ap kohen mebarek asur beyayin. Venatenu al kohen mebarek qulle nazir vequlle mesharet bammiqdash: qulle nazir, mah nazir muttar bishar mashqim hamshakkerim veeno asur ella mikkol asher yeaseh miggepen hayyayin vegam en mumin poselin bo — ap kohen mebarek en mumin poselin bo veen shear mashqin hamshakkerim moneim oto minnesiat kappayim kemo bimsharet bammiqdash, apillu nishtakker ad sheeno yakol ledabber lipne hammelek, shennesiat kappayim enah doma litpilla shehu omed umedabber im hammelek, mah sheen ken binsiat kappayim shemmedabber el haam (kemo shekkatub: "amor lahem"), ella im ken higgia leshikruto shel lot, sheaz patur mikkol hammitzvot. Vequlle mesharet bammiqdash, mah mesharet muttar beyayin kol shehu veeno muzhar ella al rebiit, shenneemar "shekar", yayin sheyyesh bo kede leshakker, veap al rebiit eno beazhara ella kesheshshetao derek shikrut rebiit bebat achat, abal im hipsiq bo o shennatan letoko meat mayim patur, mah sheen ken benazir — ap kohen mebarek im shata rebiit yayin beb' peamim o shennatan letoko meat mayim muttar, veim shata yoter merebiit ap al pi shehu mazug vaapillu shetao bekamma peamim — lo yissa kappayv ad sheyyasir yeno mealayv. Umah mepig et hayyayin — nitbaer besiman tz"t. Veyesh oserim shikkor binsiat kappayim, apillu nishtakker mishshear mashqin o okalim hamshakkerim. Ulekattechilla asur lishtot kelal mashqeh hamshakker qodem nesiat kappayim (veken nohagim). Velo natenu qulle nazir ella leinyan mumin bilbad:

Lo haya bo echad mehaddebarim hamakkebim nesiat kappayim, ap al pi shehu ra maalalim ubeliyyaal veaz panim veeno medaqdeq bemitzvot vekol haam merannenim acharayv — nose kappayv, shemmitzvat aseh hi lekol kohen lissa kappayv, veen omerim larasha "hosep resha (al rishateka) vehimmana min hammitzvot". Veal titmah vetomar mah toil birkat hedyot zeh? Sheen qabbalat habberaka teluya bakkohanim ella behaqqadosh baruk hu, shenneemar: "vaani aborkem". Vaapillu merannenim acharayv baaberot chamurot kegon gilluy arayot, vaapillu noda sheharinnun hu emet, vaapillu ober veeno chozer bo kelal — nose kappayv (chutz mechillul shabbat beparhesya shehu kenokri lekol debarayv), lepi sheen shear aberot moneim nesiat kappayim ella memir dat (mishshum qenas) ushepikat damim (mishshum "yedekem damim maleu"):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheober al mitzvot sheyyisrael vekohanim shavin bahem, abal im ober al mitzvot hamyuchadot lakkohanim — qenasuhu chakamim upesaluhu mikkol maalot hakkehunna, kegon kohen shennasa gerusha o chalutza, o shennitma lemet sheeno miz' mete mitzva — eno nose kappayv, veen nohagim bo qedushsha apillu liqrot battora rishon. Vaapillu gereshah o meta — pasul ad sheyyiddor hanaa al daat rabbim mehannashim shehu asur bahen, shenneder shehuddar al daat rabbim en lo hattara. Abal keshello yiddor al daat rabbim, shemma yelek etzel chakam veyishal al nidro, lepi sheyyitzro teqapo laarayot. Abal benitma lammet en tzarik liddor, ella day sheyyashub viqabbel alayv shello yittamma od lemetim:

Yesh omerim shekkohen sheyyesh lo bat shezinneta arusa o apillu nesua, o shehemira shemmin hassetam zinneta — "et abiha hi mechallelet", veen mechuyyabim leqaddesho od liqrot battora rishon ushear maalot hakkehunna. Abal mikkol maqom nose kappayv, sheen shear aberot moneim nesiat kappayim apillu hen bo, vekol shekken bebitto (velo nahagu kedibrehem, lepi shello neemar "et abiha hi mechallelet" ella keshezzinneta beedim vehatraa ukesheheidu bipne sanhedrin, abal akshav nohagin bo qedushsha lekol dabar):

Hechalal, dehaynu hannolad meissure kehunna shehen gerusha zona chalala — eno nose kappayv, lepi sheeno bekihuno vahare hu kezar lekol dabar, kemo shekkatub beeben haezer siman z' (lepikak im nose kappayv — ober baaseh, kemo zar shennasa kappayv). Vaapillu chalal shel dibrehem, kegon hannolad mechalutza — eno nose kappayv, ap al pi shennesiat kappayim hi min hattora veober baaseh im ameru lo laalot — yesh koach beyad chakamim laaqor dabar min hattora besheb veal taaseh. Umittaam zeh kol happesulim middibre soperim — en olin apillu ameru lahem, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Ella shehappesulim shello mippene pegamam — yesh lahem latzet mibbet hakkeneset qodem "retzeh", shello yomru alehem shehem pegumim, kemo shennitbaer sham. Umikkol maqom en chiyyub alehem latzet mibbet hakkeneset, shekkevan shechakamim menaum minnesiat kappayim — en oberim kelum. Abal kohanim hannimnaim minnesiat kappayim mechamat hamminhag, kegon bimqomot shennahagu shebbetok z' yeme haabelut eno nose kappayv, mippene sheen sharuy besimcha vehambarek yesh lo lihyot besimcha vetub leb, kemo shemmatzinu beyitzchaq shetztzivva laasot lo matammim qodem sheyyebarek; ubimdinot ellu shennohagim shekkol zeman haabelut apillu ad y"b chodesh al abiv veal immo vekol sheloshim al shear qerobim eno nose kappayv apillu en sham kohen ella hu apillu beyamim tobim, sheeno niqra sharuy besimcha shehare asur lelek lesimchat nissuin vekayyotze bah; vehu haddin haqqober meto baregel, shehare asur besimcha kol yemot haregel ap al pi sheadayin lo chal alayv haabelut, veken haonen apillu beyom tob shehu chayyab bekol hammitzvot, mikkol maqom eno sharuy besimcha — hare kullam chayyabin latzet mibbet hakkeneset qodem sheqqore hashsheliach tzibbur "kohanim" shello yaabru baaseh, shehare min haddin hem rashshaim lissa kappehem. Veyesh lahem latzet qodem "retzeh", kede shello yomru alehem shehem pegumim. Veim ameru lahem laalot o littol yedehem — chayyabim laalot im ameru lahem qodem siyyum birkat "aboda", kede shello yaabru baaseh. Laken lo yihyu bebet hakkeneset kesheomerim lakkohanim littol yedehem:

Veken kohen shehu panuy veeno rotzeh lissa kappayv mippene shehashsharuy belo ishsha sharuy belo simcha — chayyab latzet mibbet hakkeneset qodem qeriat "kohanim", shello yomru lo laalot o littol yadayv. Abal hamminhag hu shennose kappayv ap al pi sheeno nasuy (umikkol maqom harotzeh shello lissa kappayv velatzet mibbet hakkeneset — en mochin beyado sheyyesh lo al mah lismok. Abal nasuy sheen ishto immo — nose kappayv ledibre hakkol):

Nahagu bekol medinot ellu sheen nesiat kappayim ella beyom tob, mishshum sheaz sheruyim besimchat yom tob, ve"tob leb hu yebarek", mah sheen ken bishar yamim apillu beshabbatot hem terudim al michyatam veal bittul melaktam veenam sheruyim besimcha. Vaapillu beyom tob en nesiat kappayim ella bitpillat musap, sheyyotzeim az mibbet hakkeneset veyetibu libbam veyismechu besimchat yom tob. Veyom hakkippurim ap al pi sheen bo simchat akila ushetiyya — noseim kappayim bo kemo beyom tob, mippene sheyyesh bo simchat mechila uselicha vekappara uqedushsha ukebod hayyom bemalbushim naim. Umittaam zeh yesh meqomot shennoseim kappayim bo apillu beshacharit. Veyesh meqomot shennoseim kappayim bo gam binila, mippene shehu samuk layyetzia mibbet hakkeneset, kemo shehu hattaam bishar yom tob. Abal yom tob veyom kippur shechal lihyot beshabbat — lo haya rauy lepi zeh lebattel nesiat kappayim miom tob zeh bishbil sheyyesh bo qedushsha nosepet shel shabbat, ella sheyyesh meqomot shennahagu ken shello lissa kappehem beyom tob shechal lihyot bashshabbat, lepi shemminhag hakkohanim litbol linsiat kappayim vetobelin meereb yom tob veen nizqaqin linshotehem beyom tob, ukeshechal beshabbat lo ratzu lebattel haona, velo ratzu litbol shacharit mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman shk"v (abal beyom hakkippurim shechal beshabbat lo shayyak taam zeh). Umikkol maqom im lel yom tob shechal beemtza shabua shehu lel tebila — yeshammesh veyitbol beyom tob. Abal happoreshim minneshotehem belel yom tob veen tobelin beereb yom tob — shibbush gamur hu. Vekol teamim ellu hem leyashsheb hamminhag ap sheen bahem keday lebattel mitzvat aseh shel tora, mikkol maqom kesheen qoreim "kohanim" — enam oberim kelum. Abal mikkol maqom, yishar kocham shel bene eretz yisrael usebibotehem shennoseim kappehem bekol yom ketiqqun chakamim, umeqayyemim g' mitzvot aseh bekol yom, veen chosheshin litbol. Vekol shacharit umusap sheen nesiat kappayim bimdinot ellu — omer hashsheliach tzibbur: "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'", apillu hu kohen, shello maneu lakkohen ella liqrot "kohanim" ulehaqrotan umin hattaam shennitbaer lemala, abal lomar kak "kohanim am qedosheka" setam belo qeria — muttar lekattechilla (veen lachosh shekkesheyyishmeu sheyyomar "kohanim am qedosheka" yomru alayv shehu eno biklal kohanim ella ben gerusha vachalutza, lepi shehakkol yodeim shennussach hattepilla kak hu, shemmittaam kayyotze bezeh muttar lekohen liqrot lekohen acher leseper tora kemo shennitbaer besiman ql"h):

Beellu hattebot nahagu hakkohanim shehopekin bahem penehem laddarom velatztzapon: "yebarekka", "veyishmereka", "eleka", "vichunnekka", "eleka", "leka", "shalom", lepi shekkol tebot ellu hem lenokach, laken hopekin penehem gam laddarom velatztzapon kede sheyyitbareku kullam (ubetebat "shalom", mippene shehu sop habberaka veiqqaro, ki birkato shel haqqadosh baruk hu hu "shalom", laken mebarekim lekullam beshalom[)]. Venohagim lehaarik besop tebot ellu, mippene shekkol echad mehem hu sop beraka bipne atzmah. Venakon shehaomerim "ribbono shel olam chalom chalamti ku'" — sheyyomru beshaa shehakkohanim maarikim beniggun besop hatteba shebbesop happasuq, shekkebar kolta beraka zo mippi hakkohanim veen tzarik od lehaazin lahem, abal beod shehem omerim tebot habberaka — tzarik lehaazin lahem ulekavven veasur lomar shum dabar, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veap shechakamim hittiru lomar "ribbono shel olam" al chalomot mippene hassakkana shemma tzarik repua lachalomo, mikkol maqom kevan sheepshar letaqqen zeh lomar bishat haarakat hanniggun shebbesop hatteba — yesh letaqqen. Veap al pi sherpuato eno ella kesheomer "ribbono shel olam ku'" bishat birkat kohanim velo leachar shekkolta beraka mippi kohanim, mikkol maqom kol zeman shehem maarikim beniggun habarat ot acharona shel hatteba — adayin lo nistayyema teba zo leinyan shello toil az amirat "ribbono shel olam ku'" (kevan shehatztzibbur lo anu adayin amen), ap al pi shennistayyema leinyan sheen tzarik lehaazin od lakkohanim, kevan sheheezin kebar techillat habarat ot acharona, vehaarakat hahabara beniggun en tzarik lishmoa kelal. Veap al pi shebbetebat "shalom" hen maarikim beniggun qodem sheyyomru me"m shel "shalom", ukesheomerim az "ribbono shel olam" umesayyemim im hakkohanim im ken en shomea hamme"m shel "shalom" karauy lishmoa beshtiqa vekavvana, mikkol maqom betebat "veyishmereka" "vichunnekka" sheepshar letaqqen sheyyishmeu gam haot haacharona — metaqqenim. Umikkol maqom, ap sheomerim "ribbono shel olam" keshehem maarikim beniggun sop happasuq — lo yomar hammaqre "ribbono shel olam ku'" apillu eno sheliach tzibbur, shehare apillu laanot amen asur mippene hatterup. Veen tzarik lomar shehashsheliach tzibbur lo yomar "ribbono shel olam", mippene shehu hepseq battepilla:

Kol kohen yesh lo laasot shum dabar paam achat bashshana lehachaziq et atzmo bikhunna, kegon liqqach mattanot im eno yakol lissa kappayv mechamat ezeh ones, kegon shemmelammed letalmidayv beet shehatztzibbur neesapim lebet hakkeneset, o shehu choleh bemeayv veeno yakol leshahot neqabayv ad gemar birkat kohanim:

Asur lehishtammesh bekohen apillu bizman hazzeh ukemoel beheqdesh hu, shehare neemar "veqiddashto ki et lechem eloheka hu maqrib". Veap akshav sheen lanu qorbanot — biqdushshato hu omed. Veim hakkohen hu mochel al kebodo — muttar, shehakkehunna shello hi veyakol limchol kebodo velitten reshut leyisrael lehishtammesh bo. Veyesh mi sheomer sheeno yakol litten reshut lehishtammesh bo, ella im ken yesh lo ezeh hanaa kegon besakar, o apillu bechinnam leadam chashub shehu chapetz leshammesho veneheneh mizzeh shezzaka lesharet baqqodesh, abal im en lo shum hanaa mizzeh — eno yakol limchol, shenneemar: "veqiddashto", vedareshu chakamim: qaddeshehu beal korcho. (Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona, shehare yakol litten reshut leyisrael liqrot ulebarek lepanayv ap al pi sheen lo shum hanaa mizzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ql"h vr"a. Veen omerim "veqiddashto" beal korcho ella bidbarim hatteluyim biqdushshat hakkohanim, sheeno rashshay lechallel qedushshato velissa gerusha vekayyotze bah, lepi sheqqedushshat hakkohanim lo nittena lahem lehanot bah gupam, kemo sheqqedushshat yisrael lo nittena lehanot bah gupam, shemmitzvot lav lehanot nittenu ella gezerat melek hi alehem sheyyihyu qedoshim, hoil venibcharu lesharet lammelek haqqadosh, kemo shekkatub: "qedoshim tihyu ki qadosh" vego', "qadosh yihyeh … ki qadosh vego'", lepikak enah beyadam lemochlah. Abal kebod hakkehunna nittan lahem lahanaatam, laalot lattora rishon, velittol mana yapa rishon, veken lehaqdimam lekol dabar shebbiqdushsha, kabod zeh hanaat haggup hu, lepikak hu beyadam limchol kebodam, verashshay litteno leyisrael im ratza, ki retzono shel adam — zehu kebodo):
